chain.step: Fa sets v = Hr(); passes v to recent-thread ro
ro -> bo -> ho item receives navigateToLocalConversation; ho onSelect invokes yo unless supplied onSelectResult callback handles selection
yo local/remote branches pass threadKey and optional nonlocal hostId into DF
DF reads local threadId via Pa=N7r -> N4. Sidebar key local: prefix is removed. Y returns the extracted value unchanged in this frozen build.
DF normal local branch calls local navigation hook iJ. iJ Rm=Y retains ID, $u=Hht renders /local/{ID}; optional hostId/threadAccess are URLSearchParams.

conditions: The default selection chain applies only when onSelectResult is absent; standalone command-menu windows may supply an override.
